title: Template manifest (templates/manifest.json)
description: T90 — one row per file `sta init` materializes into a target project, with the content hash and framework version it was built from. This is the anchor `sta upgrade`/`migrate`/`rollback` (T94-T97) diff against: a file whose on-disk hash in the target project still matches the recorded `sha256` was never edited by the user and is safe to overwrite; one that doesn't is a user edit and upgrade must skip it, not clobber it.

framework_version.description: orchestrator/package.json's own version at build time — one number, read rather than duplicated.

path.description: Repo-root-relative, forward-slashed — identical to where it lands in the target project.
